info.description: La Rosa Holdings Corp. operates as a holding company, which provides real estate brokerage services. It sells technology-based products and services primarily to sales agents and the sales agents associated with its franchisees. The company operates through the five reportable segments: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services, Franchising Services, Coaching Services, Property Management, and Commercial Real Estate Brokerage Services. The Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services segment engages in the real estate brokerage business. The Franchising Services segment engages in the franchising of real estate brokerage agencies. The Coaching Services segment engages in the delivery of coaching services to its brokers and franchisee's brokers. The Property Management segment engages in the training of its sales agents to provide residential property management services to owners of single family residential properties. The Commercial Real Estate Brokerage Services segment engages in the brokering of the sale of commercial real estate. La Rosa Holdings was founded by Joseph La Rosa in 2004 and is headquartered in Celebration, FL.

info.description: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It operates through the Banking and Consumer Finance segments. The firm also offers non-banking activities, such as securities underwriting and dealing activities, insurance agency and underwriting activities, and merchant banking and equity investment activities. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Gallipolis, OH.
info.description_zh: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它透過銀行和消費金融部門運作。該公司還提供非銀行業務，例如證券承銷和交易活動、保險代理和承銷活動以及商業銀行和股權投資活動。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於俄亥俄州加利波利斯。

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Bitdeer Technologies Group engages in the cryptocurrency mining industry. It generates income through its proprietary mining datacenters. The firm handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. The company was founded by Wu Jihan in December 2021 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 比特鹿科技集團從事加密貨幣挖礦產業。它透過其專有的採礦資料中心產生收入。該公司處理與計算相關的複雜流程，如設備採購、運輸物流、資料中心設計和建造、設備管理和日常營運。該公司由吳忌寒於2021年12月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Tuniu Corp. is an online leisure travel company, which engages in the provision of travel-related services in China. It offers packaged tours, including organized tours and self-guided tours, and also travel-related services for leisure travelers. Its product portfolio includes organized tours, self-guided tours, and tickets for various domestic and overseas tourist attractions. The company was founded by Dunde Yu and Hai Feng Yan in 2006 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: 途牛公司是一家線上休閒旅遊公司，在中國提供旅遊相關服務。它為休閒遊客提供跟團遊和自助遊等跟團遊以及旅遊相關服務。其產品組合包括跟團遊、自助遊以及國內外各個旅遊景點的門票。該公司由於敦德和嚴海峰於2006年創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: Cardiff Oncology, Inc. is an oncology therapeutics company, which engages in the development of drugs that target mitosis for the treatment of various types of cancer. The firm is focused on developing onvansertib, a first-in-class, third-generation Polo-like Kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor, in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy and targeted therapeutics. Its clinical programs include KRAS-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC), Resistant Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC) and relapsed or refractory Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML). The company was founded by Gabriel M. Cerrone, L. David Tomei, Samuil Umansky, and Hovsep Melkonyan in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cardiff Oncology, Inc.是一家腫瘤治療公司，致力於開發針對有絲分裂的藥物，用於治療各種類型的癌症。該公司專注於開發 onvansertib，這是一種一流的第三代 Polo 樣激酶 1 (PLK1) 抑制劑，與標準護理化療和標靶治療相結合。其臨床項目包括 KRAS 突變的轉移性結直腸癌 (mCRC)、抗藥性轉移性去勢抵抗性前列腺癌 (mCRPC) 和復發或難治性急性髓系白血病 (AML)。該公司由 Gabriel M. Cerrone、L. David Tomei、Samuil Umansky 和 ​​Hovsep Melkonyan 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. The fund utilizes a proprietary model to identify "Retail Kings"-companies that are favorites or trending leaders in online investor communities-while further vetting them for fundamental resilience and competitive moats.
info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Diginex Ltd. (Hong Kong) is a blockchain financial services and technology company. Its products include diginexESG, diginexLUMEN, diginexAPPRISE, diginexLUMEN Pro, and CSRD framework. The company was founded by Miles Christian Pelham on May 15, 2020 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Diginex Ltd.（香港）是一家區塊鏈金融服務和科技公司。其產品包括 diginexESG、daginexLUMEN、daginexAPPRISE、daginexLUMEN Pro 和 CSRD 框架。該公司由 Miles Christian Pelham 於 2020 年 5 月 15 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2x (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR).
info.description_zh: 單股槓桿 ETF，尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR) 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF 尋求 Vistra Corp.（NYSE：VST）每日股價變動百分比兩倍（200%）的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of a security software platform. Its software enables enterprises and industries to protect data stored in the cloud and on-premises including sensitive files and emails, confidential personal data belonging to customers, patients, and employees, financial records, source code, strategic, and product plans, and other intellectual property. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Rest of the World. The company was founded by Yakov Faitelson and Ohad Korkus on November 3, 2004 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Varonis Systems, Inc. 從事提供安全軟體平台。其軟體使企業和行業能夠保護儲存在雲端和本地的數據，包括敏感文件和電子郵件、屬於客戶、患者和員工的機密個人資料、財務記錄、原始程式碼、策略和產品計劃以及其他智慧財產權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲以及世界其他地區。該公司由 Yakov Faitelson 和 Ohad Korkus 於 2004 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Lazard Japanese Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equities and equity-related securities (i.e., shares, including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights) traded on markets in Japan. The investment manager seeks to invest in the equity and equity-related securities of companies operating in sectors which have been identified through research undertaken by the Investment Manager as showing greater potential for growth at any given point of the economic cycle. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard 日本股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於在日本市場交易的股票和股票相關證券（即股票，包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利）。投資經理尋求投資於投資經理進行的研究已確定在經濟週期的任何給定點顯示出更大增長潛力的行業中運營的公司的股權和股權相關證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. is an exploration and production company, which engages in selling oil and natural gas products. The company was founded on February 6, 2023 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.description_zh: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc.是一家勘探和生產公司，從事石油和天然氣產品的銷售。該公司成立於2023年2月6日，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: PC Connection, Inc. engages in the development and provision of information technology solutions. It operates through the following segments: Business Solutions, Enterprise Solutions and Public Sector Solutions. The Business Solutions segment includes outbound telemarketing, on-site sales solicitation and Internet sales. The Enterprise Solutions segment offers method of sourcing, evaluating, purchasing and tracking of IT products and services. The Public Sector segment offers outbound telemarketing, including some on-site sales solicitation by business development managers, and Internet sales through Internet Business Accounts. The company was founded by Patricia J. Gallup and David Hall in 1982 and is headquartered in Merrimack, NH.

info.description: Bit Digital, Inc. provides cloud services for customers such as artificial intelligence ("AI") and machine learning ("ML") developers. It operates through following segment: Digital Asset Mining, Cloud Services, Colocation Services, and ETH Staking. The Digital Asset Mining segment engages in mining activities. The Cloud Services segment provides computing services to support generative AI workstreams. The Colocation Services segment provides physical space, power and cooling within the data center facilities to customers. The Ethereum Staking segment includes service fee and reward-sharing fees to the service providers. The company was founded in November 2015 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Bit Digital, Inc. 為人工智慧（「AI」）和機器學習（「ML」）開發人員等客戶提供雲端服務。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產挖礦、雲端服務、託管服務和 ETH 質押。數位資產採礦部門從事採礦活動。雲端服務部門提供運算服務來支援生成式人工智慧工作流程。託管服務部門為客戶提供資料中心設施內的實體空間、電力和冷卻。以太坊 Stake 部分包括向服務提供者提供的服務費和獎勵分享費。該公司成立於2015年11月，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Power Solutions International, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and trade of power systems and electrical power generation equipment. The firm provides integrated turnkey solutions to global original equipment manufacturers and end-user customers within the energy, industrial, and transportation end markets. The company was founded by Gary S. Winemaster, Kenneth J. Winemaster, and William Winemaster in February 1985 and is headquartered in Wood Dale, IL.
info.description_zh: Power Solutions International, Inc. 從事電力系統和發電設備的設計、製造和貿易。該公司為能源、工業和運輸終端市場的全球原始設備製造商和最終用戶客戶提供整合的交鑰匙解決方案。該公司由 Gary S. Winemaster、Kenneth J. Winemaster 和 William Winemaster 於 1985 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州伍德戴爾。

info.description: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to the digital asset Dogecoin (DOGE). The Trust functions as a transparent investment vehicle, holding Dogecoin in institutional-grade custody to allow investors to participate in the price movements of the cryptocurrency without the complexities of managing digital wallets or private keys.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支持的數位資產狗狗幣 (DOGE) 曝險。該信託基金作為一種透明的投資工具，以機構級託管方式持有狗狗幣，使投資者能夠參與加密貨幣的價格變動，而無需管理數位錢包或私鑰的複雜性。

info.description: Canary Staked SUI ETF is a spot digital asset exchange-traded product that provides regulated exposure to the price of SUI, the native token of the Sui Layer-1 blockchain, while simultaneously participating in the network's proof-of-stake validation process. The fund enables investors to capture both the price performance of SUI and net in-kind staking rewards, which are reflected in the fund's net asset value (NAV) without the need for direct digital wallet management.
info.description_zh: Canary Staked SUI ETF 是一種現貨數位資產交易所交易產品，提供受監管的 SUI（Sui Layer-1 區塊鏈的原生代幣）價格曝險，同時參與網路的權益證明驗證過程。該基金使投資者能夠捕獲 SUI 的價格表現和淨實物質押獎勵，這些獎勵反映在基金的資產淨值（NAV）中，而無需直接數位錢包管理。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: VersaBank engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through Digital Banking and DRTC. The Digital Banking segment offers business to business model using its financial technoolgy to address issues in the U.S. banking market. The DRTC segment refers to developed IT security software and capabilities. The company was founded by David Roy Taylor on January 18, 1993 and is headquartered in London, Canada.
info.description_zh: VersaBank 從事提供金融服務。它透過數位銀行和 DRTC 運作。數位銀行部門利用其金融科技提供企業對企業模式來解決美國銀行市場的問題。 DRTC 部分是指開發的 IT 安全軟體和功能。該公司由David Roy Taylor於1993年1月18日創立，總部位於加拿大倫敦。

info.description: Simmons First National Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and other financial products and services to individual and corporate customers. The company was founded on March 23, 1903 and is headquartered in Pine Bluff, AR.

info.description_zh: Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. 為電力產業設計、製造和部署電池儲存解決方案。它提供Eos Znyth直流電池系統產品，該產品旨在滿足電網規模儲能市場的要求。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Ferroglobe PLC is a holding company, which engages in the production of silicon and specialty metals. The firm's products include silicon metal, manganese alloys, ferrosilicon, calcium silicon, and electrodes. It operates through the following segments: North America Silicon Metals, North America Silicon Alloys, Europe Manganese, Europe Silicon Metals, Europe Silicon Alloys, South Africa Silicon Metals, South Africa Silicon Alloys, and Other. The company was founded on February 5, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Ferroglobe PLC 是一家控股公司，從事矽和特種金屬的生產。該公司的產品包括金屬矽、錳合金、矽鐵、矽鈣和電極。它透過以下部門運作：北美金屬矽部門、北美矽合金部門、歐洲錳部門、歐洲金屬矽部門、歐洲矽合金部門、南非金屬矽部門、南非矽合金部門等。該公司成立於2015年2月5日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Cosmos Health, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company, which engages in the importation, exportation, distribution, and sale of pharmaceutical products. It is also involved in the research and development of its business units, and acquisition of pharmaceutical companies. The firm offers over-the-counter drugs, branded and generic medicines, and dietary and vitamin supplements. The company was founded on July 21, 2009 and is headquartered in Thessaloniki, Greece.
info.description_zh: Cosmos Health, Inc.是一家製藥公司，從事醫藥產品的進口、出口、分銷和銷售。它也參與其業務部門的研發以及製藥公司的收購。該公司提供非處方藥、品牌藥和仿製藥、膳食補充劑和維生素補充劑。該公司成立於2009年7月21日，總部位於希臘塞薩洛尼基。

info.description: Seres Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of biological drugs through microbiome therapeutics platform. Its product pipeline includes SER-109, SER-287, SER-301, and SER-401. The company was founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn, David A. Berry, and Noubar B. Afeyan on October 18, 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Seres Therapeutics, Inc.透過微生物組治療平台從事生物藥物的開發。其產品線包括SER-109、SER-287、SER-301和SER-401。該公司由 Geoffrey von Maltzahn、David A. Berry 和 Noubar B. Afeyan 於 2010 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapies to address unmet need in oncology. The firm focuses on the field of antibody masking technologies through the development of its Probody therapeutic platform. The company was founded by Frederick W. Gluck, Nancy E. Stagliano, and Patrick S. Daugherty in February 2008 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發療法來解決腫瘤學中未滿足的需求。該公司透過開發 Probody 治療平台專注於抗體掩蔽技術領域。該公司由 Frederick W. Gluck、Nancy E. Stagliano 和 Patrick S. Daugherty 於 2008 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Bank7 Corp. is bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions. The company was founded by William Brad Haines in 2004 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK.
info.description_zh: Bank7 Corp.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供銀行解決方案。該公司由 William Brad Haines 於 2004 年創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州俄克拉荷馬市。

info.description: Belite Bio, Inc. engages in the research and development of drugs. It focuses on the treatment of eye diseases involving retinal degeneration such as atrophic age-related macular degeneration and autosomal recessive Stargardt disease. It also caters to metabolic diseases such as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, type 2 diabetes, and gout. The company was founded by Yu-Hsin Lin on March 27, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Belite Bio, Inc. 從事藥物的研究和開發。它專注於治療涉及視網膜變性的眼部疾病，例如萎縮性老年黃斑部病變和體染色體隱性遺傳斯塔加特氏症。它也針對非酒精性脂肪肝、非酒精性脂肪性肝炎、第二型糖尿病和痛風等代謝性疾病。該公司由 Yu-Hsin Lin 於 2018 年 3 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NVDA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to NVDA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求 NVDA 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long IREN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of IREN. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of IREN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 IREN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 IREN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 IREN 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: DLocal Ltd. engages in the business of simplifying and redefining online payments experience. It focuses on processing payment transactions which enables merchants to get paid from customers and to make payments to customers in emerging markets. The company was founded by Andres Bzurovski Bay and Sergio Enrique Fogel Kaplan in 2016 and is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay.

The firm also designs contracts to manufacture and sell fashionable and value-priced merchandise under the brand names of The Children's Place, Baby Place, and Gymboree. It operates through the following segments: The Children's Place U.S. and The Children's Place International. The Children's Place U.S. segment refers to the company's U.S. and Puerto Rico-based stores and revenue from its U.S. based wholesale business. The Children's Place International segment is involved in the Canadian-based stores, revenue from the company's Canadian-based wholesale business and revenue from international franchisees. The company was founded by David Pulver and Clinton A. Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: The Children's Place, Inc. 從事為兒童提供服裝、鞋類、配件和其他物品的業務。該公司還設計合同，以 The Children's Place、Baby Place 和 Gymboree 品牌製造和銷售時尚且物有所值的商品。它透過以下部門運作：The Children's Place U.S. 和 The Children's Place International。 Children's Place 美國部門是指該公司位於美國和波多黎各的商店以及來自美國批發業務的收入。 Children's Place International 部門涉及加拿大的商店、公司加拿大批發業務的收入以及國際特許經營商的收入。該公司由 David Pulver 和 Clinton A. Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: Pyxis Oncology, Inc. engages in the business of developing a multi-modality portfolio of next-generation therapeutics to target difficult-to-treat cancers and improve quality of life for patients. The firm focuses on the development of product candidates to directly kill tumor cells and to address the underlying pathologies created by cancer that enable its uncontrollable proliferation and immune evasion. The company was founded by David Steinberg, Shaan C. Gandhi, and John L. Flavin on June 11, 2018 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Pyxis Oncology, Inc. 從事開發下一代多模式治療藥物組合的業務，以針對難以治療的癌症並改善患者的生活品質。該公司專注於開發直接殺死腫瘤細胞的候選產品，並解決癌症造成的導致其無法控制的增殖和免疫逃脫的潛在病理。該公司由 David Steinberg、Shaan C. Gandhi 和 John L. Flavin 於 2018 年 6 月 11 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: TDH Holdings, Inc. is a real estate management company, that focuses on owning, operating and managing commercial real estate properties. It provides office services for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded by Rong Feng Cui on April 22, 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: TDH Holdings, Inc. 是一家房地產管理公司，專注於擁有、經營和管理商業房地產。為中小企業提供辦公服務。該公司由崔榮峰於2002年4月22日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. engages in the provision of consumer technology products and services. It operates through two business segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment includes operations in all states and territories of the U.S., operating under various brand names, including Best Buy, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Magnolia Audio Video, and Pacific Sales. The International segment consists of operations in Canada. It also markets its products under the brand names: Best Buy, bestbuy.com, Best Buy Express, Lively, Geek Squad, Magnolia and Pacific Kitchen and Home. The company was founded by Richard M. Schulze in 1966 and is headquartered in Richfield, MN.
info.description_zh: Best Buy Co., Inc. 從事提供消費性科技產品和服務。它透過兩個業務部門運作：國內和國際。國內部門包括在美國所有州和地區的業務，以各種品牌運營，包括 Best Buy、Best Buy Mobile、Geek Squad、Magnolia Audio Video 和 Pacific Sales。國際部門包括加拿大的業務。它還以以下品牌銷售其產品：Best Buy、bestbuy.com、Best Buy Express、Lively、Geek Squad、Magnolia 和 Pacific Kitchen and Home。該公司由 Richard M. Schulze 於 1966 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州里奇菲爾德。

info.description: The Bank of New York Mellon Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following segments: Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other. The Securities Services segment includes the Asset Servicing business, which provides global custody, fund accounting, integrated middle-office solutions, transfer agency and data, and analytics solutions. The Market and Wealth Services segment consists of the Pershing, Clearance and Collateral Management, and Treasury Services businesses. The Investment and Wealth Management segment is involved in services to institutional and retail investors, as well as investment management, wealth, and estate planning. The Other segment refers to the leasing portfolio, corporate treasury activities, derivatives, and other trading activity. The company was founded by Alexander Hamilton on June 9, 1784 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment. The Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. The Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和專業解決方案部門以及全球醫療產品和分銷部門運營。製藥和專業解決方案部門在美國分銷品牌和仿製藥、專業藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。全球醫療產品和分銷部門生產、採購和分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品，這些產品銷往美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲和其他市場。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. engages in the retail of beauty products. The firm also includes salon and e-commerce services. Its products include makeup, skin care, tools and brushes, fragrance, and bath and body. The company was founded on January 9, 1990 and is headquartered in Bolingbrook, IL.

info.description: Vistra Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of electricity and power generation. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Texas, East, West, and Asset Closure. The Retail segment includes sale of electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Texas and East segments are involved in electricity generation, wholesale energy sales and purchases, commodity risk management activities, fuel production and fuel logistics management. The West segment represents the company's electricity generation operations in CAISO. The Asset Closure segment refers to the decommissioning and reclamation of retired plants and mines. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Vistra Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供電力和發電業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：零售部門、德州部門、東部部門、西部部門和資產關閉部門。零售部門包括向住宅、商業和工業客戶銷售電力和天然氣。德州和東部部門從事發電、批發能源銷售和採購、商品風險管理活動、燃料生產和燃料物流管理。西部部門代表該公司在 CAISO 的發電業務。資產關閉部分是指退役工廠和礦山的退役和復墾。該公司成立於 1882 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Wells Fargo & Co. is a diversified and community-based financial services company, which engages in the provision of banking, insurance, investments, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Consumer Banking and Lending segment offers consumer and small business banking, home lending, credit cards, auto, and personal lending. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking and credit products across industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment is composed of corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, and equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities. The Wealth and Investment Management segment refers to personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust, and fiduciary products and services. The company was founded by Henry Wells and William G. Fargo on March 18, 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: 富國銀行是一家多元化、以社區為基礎的金融服務公司，從事提供銀行、保險、投資、抵押貸款以及消費者和商業金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和貸款部門、商業銀行部門、企業和投資銀行部門以及財富和投資管理部門。消費者銀行和貸款部門提供消費者和小型企業銀行業務、房屋貸款、信用卡、汽車和個人貸款。商業銀行部門提供跨行業和市政當局的銀行和信貸產品、擔保貸款和租賃產品以及資金管理。企業和投資銀行部門由企業銀行、投資銀行、資金管理、商業房地產貸款和服務、股票和固定收益解決方案以及銷售、交易和研究能力組成。財富與投資管理部門指個人化財富管理、經紀、財務規劃、貸款、私人銀行、信託和信託產品和服務。該公司由 Henry Wells 和 William G. Fargo 於 1852 年 3 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州舊金山。

info.description: Fuel Tech, Inc. engages in the development, commercialization and application of proprietary technologies for air pollution control, process optimization, water treatment, and advanced engineering services. It operates through the following segments: Air Pollution Control, Fuel Chem Technologies, and Other. The Air Pollution Control Technology segment includes technologies to reduce nitrogen oxides emissions in flue gas from boilers, incinerators, furnaces, and other stationary combustion sources. The Fuel Chem Technology segment uses chemical processes in combination with computational fluid dynamics, and chemical kinetics modeling boiler modeling, for the control of slagging, fouling, corrosion, opacity, and other sulfur trioxide-related issues in furnaces, and boilers. info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long QCOM Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為高通公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily QCOM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of QCOM. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of QCOM and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to QCOM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. info.description_zh: Direxion Daily QCOM Bull 2X Shares 尋求 QCOM 每日績效的 200% 的每日投資收益（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 QCOM 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些組合為 QCOM 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description_zh: 華納音樂集團公司從事音樂出版和錄製。它透過錄製音樂和音樂出版部門運作。錄製音樂部門涉及公司唱片藝術家製作的錄製音樂的銷售、行銷、分銷和授權。音樂出版部門充當音樂作品的版權所有者和/或管理員，並產生與音樂作品的利用相關的收入。該公司成立於2003年11月21日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: MKAM ETF seeks to capture the majority of equity market returns, while exposing investors to less volatility and downside risk than other equity investments. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. equity securities that generally mimic the performance of the S&P 500 Index while attempting to reduce volatility and mitigate drawdowns. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: MKAM ETF 旨在獲取大部分股票市場回報，同時使投資者面臨比其他股票投資更少的波動性和下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資通常模仿標準普爾 500 指數表現的美國股票證券來實現其投資目標，同時試圖減少波動性和減少回撤。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Macquarie Focused International Core ETF seeks to provide capital growth and appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the ETF will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity companies. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks of non-U.S. companies located or operating in both developed markets and emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理聚焦國際核心 ETF 致力於提供資本成長和增值。在正常情況下，ETF將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於股權公司。該基金將主要投資於位於已開發市場和新興市場或在新興市場運營的非美國公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

The fund applies proprietary data models alongside portfolio manager oversight to systematically weight holdings based on future risk-adjusted return expectations.

The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index. info.description: Xtrackers US Green Infrastructure Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive United States Green Infrastructure ESG Screened Index. info.description_zh: Xtrackers 美國綠色基礎設施精選股票 ETF 尋求與 Solactive 美國綠色基礎設施 ESG 篩選指數 (未計費用和開支) 的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支前的表現）大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在綠色能源的生產、發電或分銷領域有業務的公司或從事建立可持續基礎設施以實現可再生能源使用並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana is a holding company, which provides financial services to individuals, corporate entities, and other organizations. info.description: Galaxy Digital, Inc. engages in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. info.description_zh: Galaxy Digital, Inc. 從事數位資產和資料中心基礎設施業務，提供可加速金融和人工智慧進步的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產、資料中心、財務和企業部門。數位資產領域為機構提供交易、諮詢、資產管理、質押、自我託管和代幣化技術的存取權。資料中心部門與一系列基礎設施供應商競爭，這些供應商正在建造或重新利用設施，以支援對人工智慧和運算密集型工作負載快速成長的需求。財務和公司部門包括公司的自營交易和採礦活動，以及公司的主要投資和相關損益。該公司由 Michael Novogratz 於 2018 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: SunPower, Inc. engages in providing residential solar and energy services. The Dealer segment engages in supporting a network of independent dealers through the sale of solar products, financing solutions, and related services for residential customers. The company was founded by William J. Anderson in 2010 and is headquartered in Orem, UT.
info.description_zh: SunPower, Inc. 從事提供住宅太陽能和能源服務。它提供了一個技術支援的平台，支援全國銷售合作夥伴、經銷商和安裝專業人員網絡，為美國各地的房主和住宅建築商提供太陽能係統、電池儲存解決方案和相關服務。該公司透過以下部門營運：住宅太陽能安裝部門、新房業務部門和經銷商部門。住宅太陽能安裝部門從事住宅太陽能係統和儲能解決方案的銷售、安裝、監控和維護。新住宅業務部門致力於為住宅建築商提供太陽能係統和相關服務，以納入新建住宅。經銷商部門透過向住宅客戶銷售太陽能產品、融資解決方案和相關服務來支援獨立經銷商網路。該公司由 William J. Anderson 於 2010 年創立，總部位於猶他州奧勒姆。

info.description: QUALCOMM, Inc. engages in developing and commercializing foundational technologies and products used in mobile devices and other wireless products. It operates through the following segments: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT), Qualcomm Technology Licensing (QTL), and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives (QSI). The QCT segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software based on technologies for use in voice and data communications, networking, application processing, multimedia, and global positioning system products. The QTL segment grants licenses and provides rights to use portions of the firm's intellectual property portfolio. The QSI segment focuses on opening new or expanding opportunities for its technologies and supporting the design and introduction of new products and services for voice and data communications. The company was founded by Franklin P. Antonio, Adelia A. Coffman, Andrew Cohen, Klein Gilhousen, Irwin Mark Jacobs, Andrew J. Viterbi, and Harvey P. White in July 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: QUALCOMM, Inc. 致力於行動裝置和其他無線產品中使用的基礎技術和產品的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門營運：高通 CDMA 技術部門 (QCT)、高通技術授權部門 (QTL) 和高通策略計畫部門 (QSI)。 QCT 部門開發並提供基於語音和數據通訊、網路、應用處理、多媒體和全球定位系統產品技術的積體電路和系統軟體。 QTL 部門授予許可並提供使用公司部分智慧財產權組合的權利。 QSI 部門專注於為其技術開闢新的或擴大的機會，並支援語音和數據通訊新產品和服務的設計和推出。該公司由 Franklin P. Antonio、Adelia A. Coffman、Andrew Cohen、Klein Gilhousen、Irwin Mark Jacobs、Andrew J. Viterbi 和 Harvey P. White 於 1985 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of ceramics tiles. Its products operates through the Hengda, the Hengdeli or HDL brand, TOERTO, WULIQIAO, and Pottery Capital of Tang Dynasty brands. It offers porcelain, glazed, glazed porcelain, rustic, and polished glazed tiles. The company was founded by Jia Dong Huan on September 30, 1993 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.description_zh: 羚羊企業控股有限公司從事瓷磚的製造及銷售。其產品透過恆達、亨得利或HDL品牌、TOERTO、五里橋、唐朝陶都品牌運作。它提供瓷器、釉面、釉面瓷、仿古和拋光釉面磚。該公司由賈東歡於1993年9月30日創立，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Afya Ltd. is a medical education group, which engages in the provision of an end-to-end physician-centric ecosystem that serves and empowers students to be lifelong medical learners through their medical residency preparation, post-graduate programs, and continuing medical education activities. It operates through Education Services; and Digital Content, Residency Preparatory and Specialization Programs segments. The Education Services segment provides educational services through undergraduate and graduate courses related to medicine, other health sciences, and other undergraduate programs. The Residency Preparatory and Specialization Programs segment offers digital and printed medical content services, including online courses for residency preparatory, medical and other than medical post-graduate specialization programs and mobile app subscription for digital medical content. The company was founded on March 22, 2019 and is headquartered in Nova Lima, Brazil.
info.description_zh: Afya Ltd. 是一家醫學教育集團，致力於提供以醫生為中心的端到端生態系統，透過住院醫師準備、研究生課程和繼續醫學教育活動，為學生提供服務並使其成為終身醫學學習者。它透過教育服務機構運作；以及數位內容、住院醫師培訓準備和專業化課程部分。教育服務部門透過與醫學、其他健康科學和其他本科課程相關的本科生和研究生課程提供教育服務。住院醫師預備和專業課程部門提供數位和印刷醫學內容服務，包括住院醫師預備、醫學和非醫學研究生專業課程的線上課程以及數位醫療內容的行動應用程式訂閱。該公司成立於2019年3月22日，總部位於巴西新利馬。

info.description: AgomAb Therapeutics NV is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel disease-modifying therapies for immunology and inflammatory diseases. Its mission is to develop disease-modifying therapeutics that aim to resolve fibrosis and restore organ function, enabling patients with these disorders to live fuller and healthier lives. The company was founded by Paolo Michieli, Manuela Cazzanti, Virginia Morello, Federica Caterina Linty, Michael Potter Saunders, and Hans J. W. de Haard in 2017 and is headquartered in Ghent, Belgium.
info.description_zh: AgomAb Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發免疫學和發炎性疾病的新型疾病緩解療法。其使命是開發疾病緩解療法，旨在解決纖維化問題並恢復器官功能，使患有這些疾病的患者能夠過上更充實、更健康的生活。該公司由 Paolo Michieli、Manuela Cazzanti、Virginia Morello、Federica Caterina Linty、Michael Potter Saunders 和 Hans J. W. de Haard 於 2017 年創立，總部位於比利時根特。

info.description: Xiao-I Corp. is a holding company, which engages in Internet technology development through its subsidiaries. It focuses on business solutions and services in artificial intelligence, covering natural language processing, voice and image recognition, machine learning, and affective computing. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 小i公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事網路技術開發。專注於人工智慧領域的商業解決方案和服務，涵蓋自然語言處理、語音和圖像識別、機器學習、情感計算等。公司成立於2001年，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Katapult Holdings, Inc. is an e-commerce focused financial technology company. The firm is engaged in the provision of e-commerce point-of-sale lease-purchase options for nonprime U.S. consumers. It offers its customers a lease purchase transaction processing system with no long-term obligation and options for ownership. The company was founded in August 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Katapult Holdings, Inc. 是一家專注於電子商務的金融科技公司。該公司致力於為美國非優質消費者提供電子商務銷售點租賃購買選擇。它為客戶提供租賃購買交易處理系統，沒有長期義務和所有權選擇。該公司成立於 2019 年 8 月，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: First Trust Alternative Absolute Return Strategy ETF seeks to provide investors with long-term total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve long-term total return through long and short investments in exchange-traded commodity futures contracts ("Commodity Futures") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). It does not invest directly in Commodity Futures. The advisor gains exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary. The Subsidiary is advised by First Trust Advisors L.P., the fund's investment advisor.
info.description_zh: First Trust Alternative絕對回報策略ETF旨在為投資者提供長期總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過該基金根據開曼群島法律組成的全資子公司（「子公司」）對交易所交易商品期貨合約（「商品期貨」）進行多頭和空頭投資，以實現長期總回報。它不會直接投資於商品期貨。顧問僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。該子公司由該基金的投資顧問 First Trust Advisors L.P. 提供諮詢服務。

info.description: Limbach Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial specialty contractor services in the areas of heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, plumbing, electrical and building controls for the design and construction of new and renovated buildings, maintenance services, energy retrofits, and equipment upgrades. It operates through the General Contractor Relationships and Owner Direct Relationships segments. The General Contractor Relationships segment manages new construction or renovation projects that involve primarily HVAC, plumbing, or electrical services. The Owner Direct Relationships segment provides maintenance or services primarily on HVAC, plumbing or electrical systems, building controls and specialty contracting projects. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.

info.description_zh: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年9月28日，總部位於加州丹維爾。

info.description: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols. Its programs provide quality of care for chronic back pain caused by disc degeneration and metabolic disorders, including obesity and diabetes. The company's initial investigational therapeutic product being called BRTX-100 focuses on treating damage by an autologous stem cell product that uses own stem cells that are harvested, cultured, and then injected directly into the affected disc to start the repair process. BioRestorative Therapies was founded on June 13, 1997 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. 從事利用細胞和組織方案開發治療產品和醫學療法。其項目為椎間盤退化和代謝紊亂（包括肥胖和糖尿病）引起的慢性背痛提供優質護理。該公司最初的研究性治療產品名為 BRTX-100，專注於透過自體幹細胞產品治療損傷，該產品使用收穫、培養的自體幹細胞，然後直接注射到受影響的椎間盤中以啟動修復過程。 BioRestorative Therapies 成立於 1997 年 6 月 13 日，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description_zh: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Anna Nahajski-Staples 於 2025 年 8 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: iShares Global Clean Energy ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Global Clean Energy IndexTM composed of global equities in the clean energy sector. The index is designed to track the performance of approximately 100 clean energy-related companies. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts ("Crypto Asset Futures ETFs"), (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts ("crypto asset futures"), and (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset ("Spot Crypto Asset ETPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 數位資產生態系統 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈產業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約（「加密資產期貨ETF」）的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨交易（iv幣貨幣參考資產（「現貨加密資產 ETP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM Index (the "index"). Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is a rules-based equity index designed to track the overall performance of the 50 most undervalued stocks comprising the NASDAQ US Large Mid Cap Index TM that exhibit high levels of "relative strength."
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少90%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的股票指數，旨在追蹤納斯達克美國大中型股指數 TM 中最被低估的 50 隻股票的整體表現，這些股票表現出高水平的「相對強度」。

info.description: Hallador Energy Co. engages in business through its subsidiary, Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces coal in the Illinois Basin for the electric power generation industry. It also owns summit terminal, a transport facility on the Ohio River. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Terre Haute, IN.

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide comprehensive, uncapped exposure to the financials sector by utilizing a hybrid investment approach. The fund addresses the limitations of traditional market-cap-weighted sector indexes-which often underweight the largest constituents to maintain regulatory compliance-by combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to more accurately reflect the sector's true market-capitalization composition.
info.description_zh: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過利用混合投資方式提供全面、無上限的金融業投資。該基金透過將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，解決了傳統市值加權產業指數的局限性（該指數通常會低估最大的成分股以維持監管合規性），以更準確地反映該行業的真實市值組成。

info.description: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and natural language processing to derive a proprietary News Media Sentiment Signal (the "Sentiment Signal"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large, mid and small capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過利用人工智慧（「AI」）和自然語言處理來得出專有的新聞媒體情緒訊號（「情緒訊號」）的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市的大、中、小型資本公司的證券。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kyivstar Group Ltd. engages in the telecommunications and digital business. It provides mobile, digital and fixed-line services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of TSLA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to TSLA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 TSLA 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）達到 TSLA 每日業績的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 TSLA 證券以及為 TSLA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fusion Fuel Green Plc engages in the research and development of solar technologies. It develops a process and technology to produce emission-free green hydrogen using concentrated photovoltaic technology. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fusion Fuel Green Plc 從事太陽能技術的研究和開發。它開發了一種利用聚光光伏技術生產無排放綠色氫的製程和技術。該公司成立於2018年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Scienjoy Holding Corp. provides mobile entertainment live streaming platforms in China. The firm operates its platforms on both PC and mobile apps, through which users can enjoy immersive and interactive entertainment live streaming. Its different platforms include broadcaster policy, events, promotion and games. The firm also provides technological infrastructure to enable broadcasters, online users, and viewers to interact with each other during live streaming. The company was founded by Xiao Wu He, Pei Lu & Bo Wan in October 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Scienjoy Holding Corp. 在中國提供行動娛樂直播平台。該公司在PC和行動應用程式上經營其平台，用戶可以透過這些平台享受身臨其境的互動娛樂直播。其不同平台包括廣播公司政策、活動、促銷和遊戲。該公司還提供技術基礎設施，使廣播公司、線上用戶和觀眾能夠在直播過程中相互互動。該公司由何曉武、盧培和萬博於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: CoreWeave, Inc. engages in the powers of the creation and delivery of the intelligence that drives innovation. It offers a solution used by organizations of all sizes that require sophisticated AI computing, from the largest of enterprises to small, well-funded start-ups. The company was founded by Michael Intrator, Brian Venturo, Peter Salanki, and Brannin McBee on September 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Livingston, NJ.
info.description_zh: CoreWeave, Inc. 致力於創造和交付推動創新的智慧。它提供的解決方案可供各種規模的需要複雜人工智慧運算的組織使用，從最大的企業到資金充足的小型新創公司。該公司由 Michael Intrator、Brian Venturo、Peter Salanki 和 Brannin McBee 於 2017 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於新澤西州利文斯頓。

info.description: Intel Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of computer products and technologies. It delivers computer, networking, data storage, and communications platforms. The firm operates through the following segments: Client Computing Group (CCG), Data Center and AI (DCAI), Intel Foundry Services (IFS), and All Other. The CCG segment consists of platforms designed for notebooks, 2-in-1 systems, desktops, tablets, phones, wireless and wired connectivity products, and mobile communication components. The DCAI segment delivers solutions to cloud service providers and enterprise customers, along with silicon devices for communications service providers and high-performance computing customers. The IFS segment refers to full stack solutions created from the foundry industry ecosystem. The All Other segment represents results from other non-reportable segments and corporate-related charges. The company was founded by Robert Norton Noyce and Gordon Earle Moore on July 18, 1968, and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 英特爾公司從事電腦產品和技術的設計、製造和銷售。它提供電腦、網路、資料儲存和通訊平台。該公司透過以下部門運作：客戶端計算部門 (CCG)、資料中心和人工智慧 (DCAI)、英特爾代工服務 (IFS) 和所有其他部門。 CCG 部門包括專為筆記型電腦、二合一系統、桌上型電腦、平板電腦、手機、無線和有線連接產品以及行動通訊組件設計的平台。 DCAI部門為雲端服務供應商和企業客戶提供解決方案，並為通訊服務供應商和高效能運算客戶提供矽設備。 IFS 部分是指從代工產業生態系統創建的全端解決方案。所有其他部門代表其他非報告部門的績效和公司相關費用。該公司由羅伯特·諾頓·諾伊斯 (Robert Norton Noyce) 和戈登·厄爾·摩爾 (Gordon Earle Moore) 於 1968 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖克拉拉。
